description: Monthly US agricultural export shipments by destination, from USDA GATS (Census trade data) — quantities and values actually shipped, not sales contracted. Use for realized trade volumes; use get_export_sales instead for contracted-but-unshipped demand, and compare_contracts_vs_shipments for the sold-versus-shipped gap. Read-only lookup of stored Census data; no API key. Coverage is a rolling 24 months, refreshed monthly; quantities are in metric tons with values in USD. Some commodities are withheld when GATS unit inconsistencies fail a dollars-per-ton sanity check — a withheld result says so explicitly instead of returning bad numbers.

months.description: Number of months of flows to return (default 12, max 24)

partner.description: Partner country code (2-letter ISO/GENC, e.g. MX, CN) or omit for all partners

name: get_trade_flows
